ambient.h2: Specialty SOAP Notes from Voice — Before the Patient Leaves
ambient.sub: Murphi.ai listens during the clinical encounter and generates structured SOAP notes with specialty-specific fields — cardiology, sleep, allergy, pain, oncology, and more. Medication scan auto-populates from the session. Syncs to EHR automatically after clinician approval.

note.text: Patient reports improved exercise tolerance since last visit. Denies chest pain, palpitations, or syncope. Reports mild dyspnea on exertion with two flights of stairs.
BP 132/78, HR 68 bpm regular. RRR, no murmurs. Lungs CTA bilaterally. No peripheral edema. EKG: NSR, no acute changes.
Stable hypertensive heart disease. HTN well-controlled on current regimen. Dyspnea on exertion — functional, likely deconditioning.
Continue lisinopril 10mg QD. Echocardiogram ordered. Cardiac rehab referral placed. Follow up in 8 weeks or sooner PRN.
